environment.description: Lambda function deployed with Function URL using AuthType=NONE. The function URL endpoint is publicly accessible at https://abc123.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/. No API Gateway in front. The user_profiles table contains columns: id, display_name, email, bio, avatar_url, is_admin, role, account_tier, password_hash, email_verified. Any unauthenticated caller can invoke the function and set arbitrary columns including is_admin, role, account_tier, and password_hash.
